headline: Wardens Widen Hold in Weathered Expanse as Losses Mount
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has grown only fiercer: the Wardens now count two posts against five Colonial, with two in ruin, fifty-seven actions were logged across the day, and the hourly toll still climbs — some nine hundred fifty Colonial and fifteen hundred Warden in the past hour — Wightwalk the busiest ground and the fighting unbroken at press time. Callahan's Passage has again surrendered a post to no-man's-land, leaving nine Warden strongpoints and one wreck, Crumbling Post the storm centre, with near nine thousand four hundred fallen on each side in the day's ledger. Kuura Strand burst aflame inside two hours — twelve base actions, Martti, Faden Point, Menneen and Suosalo the busiest grounds — though all six posts remain Warden-held. At Mooring County the MacConmara Barrows post was struck down to no-man's-land while losses there climbed past a thousand an hour. The Nevish Line stays split, four Warden posts to three Colonial and one ruin, its latest actions logged at press time. Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm have gone quiet, the Wardens rebuilt to two posts on the Shelf. Day five hundred thirty closes with the thirty-four victory towns still unclaimed.
